purpose: Determine whether LIME fidelity and SHAP agreement limitations are specific to cross-model disagreement cases or extend across representative TP, TN, FP and FN cases.

selected_configuration.description: Continuous features with a wider local kernel

reliability_rule.qualified_fidelity: local decision agreement, local R2 >= 0.30 and fidelity gap <= 0.10
reliability_rule.qualified_cross_method: top-10 Jaccard >= 0.40 and absolute attribution cosine >= 0.50
reliability_rule.warning: These are study-specific descriptive criteria, not universal XAI standards.
